quote: CAF has secured two new contracts to supply metro units based on its INNEO platform. The company will manufacture 13 units for the Medellín Metro and 6 units for the Santiago de Chile metro. The combined contracts exceed €200 million.
note: Opened CAF English; >EUR 200m / 13 Medellín + 6 Santiago units confirmed. CapEx-fill USD via Fed H.10 Sep 25 2026 1.1400.
